note: Every universal this deck prints, and the set it ranges over.

set: every human rescore of a reading answer the state did on this spring's 64,489 requests (c3), which the Tribune reports as 'Humans conducted all re-scores.' (c7)
quantifiers.why: The universal is the source's own: c7 says humans conducted all re-scores, and c14 says TEA sends rescore requests for human scoring. The slide claims nothing beyond the set the Tribune named.

set: every rescore on this spring's 64,489 requests (c3), per 'Humans conducted all re-scores.' (c7)
quantifiers.why: The headline form of the same universal, over the same set, resting on c7.

quantifiers.about: constructed responses on English STAAR under TEA's hybrid design
set: every constructed response on English STAAR as TEA described the design in March 2024: 'All scores go through auto scoring engine' (c22); Spanish answers are excluded and scored by people alone (c16)
quantifiers.why: The slide dates the design to TEA's December 2023 and March 2024 documents and the universal is TEA's own wording.

set: all open-ended responses on reading exams, per 'In total, less than .5% of total open-ended responses on reading exams saw changes.' (c5)
quantifiers.why: The set is the Tribune's own 'total open-ended responses on reading exams'.
